pontos: Amends Law 12.087/2009, on credit guarantee funds for businesses and rural producers
Amends Law 13.999/2020, which created Pronampe, a support program for micro and small businesses
Amends the law on the Social Infrastructure Investment Fund (FIIS) and the law on the telecommunications fund
Amends MP 1.359/2026, on financing of new vehicles for ride-hailing app drivers and taxi drivers
